non_overlap: Not the active fixed-session range claim: liquidity pools are causally confirmed rolling swing/equal-high/equal-low levels and the primary state is cross-market SMT divergence.

Not the active BTC/ETH common-factor or BTC-to-alt microshock claims: no return-residual threshold defines the event; one market must physically raid pre-existing external liquidity while the paired market leaves its corresponding liquidity intact.
Not L2 cancellation/refill or passive maker research: official public trade prints only, no queue fill model or displayed-depth signal.
Not match-sweep topology: fills are aggregated into completed one-second bars and the signal requires confirmed liquidity structure, MSS/displacement and FVG.
scope: Official Bybit BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT public trade archives on six sparse 2023 dates. Build completed 1-second bars and causally confirmed 5-second swing/equal-high/equal-low liquidity pools. Detect one-market external-liquidity sweeps while the paired market does not take corresponding liquidity. Test (1) sweep-reclaim plus opposite displacement/FVG reversal in the sweeper and (2) accepted leader sweep plus laggard liquidity-transfer continuation toward its unswept pool. Entry only after confirmation plus 100ms on the next observed trade or conservative FVG midpoint trade-through; structural stop beyond sweep/internal swing, target at fixed R or paired liquidity; one global slot; 12/18/24bp identical path replay; 2024-2026 sealed; no credentials or orders.
